text:
nina (recruiter): Heads-up: Sam Nguyen (L4 Backend) asked for two accommodations for their on-site loop next Tue: CART live captioning for interviews and permission to bring their service dog. Also asked if we can start earlier (08:30am PT) because they need to travel with the dog. Can we support both?

ashley (hiring mgr): Early start ok on interviewers' side. We can push remote screen to 08:30-09:00 and onsite panel 09:30-11:30. Quick Q: will the CART be remote or in-room captioning? We should also add a note for interviewers about the service dog (allergies?).

omar (people-ops): We can arrange CART (vendor: ClearCaptions) and the service animal accommodation. Need candidate confirmation on whether dog will be on a leash and needs a mat/water bowl. Also want to notify reception & facilities 24h ahead for signage and to avoid loud announcements.

accessibility-bot: Company policy: reasonable accommodations (including CART and service animals) are provided. For CART, vendor needs agenda + Zoom link if remote, or a quiet seat in the room if in-person. For service animals, please do not ask for documentation; instead provide an accessible path and a low-sensory waiting area. We'll also notify interviewers about not petting or feeding the dog.

facilities-bot: Noted. Quiet waiting area (Lobby Alcove A) reserved 08:15-12:00 with water bowl and mat ready. Conf H reserved 09:15-12:00 for panel (we'll have a barrier-free entrance and a corner for the dog to rest). Visitor parking V2 reserved 08:00-12:30. We'll post a small sign at reception: "Service animal present 3; please check with reception before entering."

care-team: Also flag: one interviewer has a severe cat/dog allergy (noted in HR). We recommend seating adjustments and extra airflow in the room; suggest interviewer sits furthest from dog's resting spot and avoids direct contact. We can offer the allergic interviewer a remote connection if preferred.

it-support-bot: CART options: 1) Remote CART via Zoom captions (lower cost) 2) In-room CART setup with laptop + external speaker for verbatim captions. If in-room, we need a seat with power and quiet mic placement. ETA for in-room setup: 2h before start. Which do we prefer?

nina (recruiter): Sam prefers in-room CART if possible. They said the dog is crate-trained and will stay on a mat near the wall. Candidate notes no feeding or touching the dog. Also prefers a short 10min break between sessions to check on the dog.

omar (people-ops): We'll book in-room CART and a 10min buffer. I'll add a short accommodations blurb to the invite. @front-desk please prepare a privacy-friendly checklist and avoid overhead announcements.

front-desk: Checklist noted. We'll greet Sam, hand over a printed schedule, and place the dog mat and bowl in Lobby Alcove A. We'll also have a small laminated card for interviewers: "Service animal present 3; do not pet or feed."

ashley (hiring mgr): Two asks: 1) Add a calendar note: "Candidate traveling with a service dog; please avoid surprises and keep debriefs concise." 2) Provide a Zoom fallback link and disable auto-recording.

care-team: We'll offer the allergic interviewer a remote seat and provide HEPA fan near Conf H entrance to reduce dander spread. Also providing hand-sanitizer and a tissues box.

it-support-bot: In-room CART booked (ClearCaptions) 09:00-12:00. We'll place a laptop with captions on a side table and a wireless mic for the lead interviewer. Setup tech arrives 08:30. Power strip reserved.

nina (recruiter): Candidate info for logistics: Sam Nguyen, phone 415-555-0202, pronouns they/them, will arrive 08:10 with service dog "Mochi" (small labradoodle). Candidate asked whether we can cover a small taxi stipend for door-to-door given dog needs; asked for guidance on receipts.

omar (people-ops): We can issue a rideshare voucher up to $60. Request candidate submit the receipt to expenses@redwood.com with code HIRING-ACCOMM. I'll DM Sam the voucher link and attach the accommodation blurb to the invite.

front-desk: We'll have the dog-friendly waiting setup and will avoid announcing the candidate in the lobby. Reception has been briefed about not calling overhead.

ashley (hiring mgr): I'll inform interviewers to be mindful; the allergic interviewer chose to join remotely. Thanks for the HEPA fan offer.

candidate-bot: Sam confirmed receipt: "Thanks all. Mochi is crate-trained and calm. I appreciate the CART and the buffer. I'll take the rideshare voucher. See you Tue 08:30."

omar (people-ops): Calendar invites updated: 2026-12-08 08:30-09:00 remote screen (Zoom + captions), 09:30-11:30 onsite panel (Conf H) with in-room CART. Added note: "Service animal present; please do not pet or feed. Allergic interviewer joining remotely. Debriefs kept to 15m." Parking, waiting area and rideshare voucher confirmed.

nina (recruiter): Final checklist posted in invite: 
- In-room CART (ClearCaptions) reserved 09:00-12:00
- Conf H reserved 09:15-12:00 (barrier-free)
- Lobby Alcove A set as dog-friendly waiting spot (mat + water bowl)
- Visitor parking V2 reserved 08:00-12:30
- Rideshare voucher $60 issued
- Allergic interviewer joining remotely; HEPA fan placed near entrance
- Tech setup 08:30 for CART + mic

nina (recruiter): Closing thread 6: reopen if anything changes or if vendor needs additional agenda materials."
